title: 1623 Prairie's broad basement window and its scrolled iron grille
items: The basement light under Granger Farwell's arched window is now the broad, low opening of its 1886 drawing: 1.8 m across under a flat segmental arch of radiating stones.
Its iron grille follows the drawing too: close uprights with a band of curled scrolls across the top.
Sizes were read through the drawing's camera; the scrolls' exact curl is a reconstruction, recorded as a liberty.
